description: Next.js's modern file-system router built on React Server Components, nested layouts, streaming Suspense, and segment-level loading and error boundaries.
The mandatory top-level layout file in the App Router that defines the HTML and body elements shared across all routes.
The App Router rule where components execute exclusively on the server without adding JavaScript to the client bundle unless a file declares 'use client'.
The incremental Rust-based bundler used by Next.js during development and builds to deliver fast module compilation and Fast Refresh.
Storing helper functions, components, tests, and styles directly inside app/ route folders safely because only page.tsx or route.ts files expose public URLs.
